verdict: Yes. Warriorworld from Surat pitched Indian army-inspired apparel on Shark Tank India Season 5 and got a deal, with strong revenue. Pride in the forces is a powerful brand story, but use of official insignia and names needs permission.
angle: Army-inspired prints, cargos and T-shirts appeal to young men, veterans' families and fitness enthusiasts. Surat's synthetic fabric cluster keeps costs low. Avoid official insignia without permission, and build the brand around values like discipline and service.
